# Gate-entropy tables (generated by summarize.py)

Brackets: lower = max(plug-in, Renyi-2 from collisions); * = zero collisions, approximate bound log2(pairs/3); upper = min(sum of unit entropies, FVSBN/MADE held-out cross-entropy + 2 SE). Point (Miller-Madow) only if the bracket is < 1 bit wide. H(G|X): mean per-input plug-in - per-unit sum, over noise draws. E3: merged entropy (bits) at the first verified checkpoint meeting the tolerance.
